page.overview:
Who is Moiraine Damodred?

Moiraine's extraordinary achievements were many: she avoided being put on the Sun Throne as the Queen of Cairhien for years, she tracked down and became the trusted advisor of the Dragon Reborn, and most significantly, no other Third Age Aes Sedai is known to have faced—let alone survived—an encounter with a Forsaken, while Moiraine faced not one but four and defeated two of them, earning her a remarkable status as one of the most accomplished sisters in Tower history.

Her heroic deeds as a member of the circle that resealed the Dark One's prison and surviving the Tower of Ghenjei likely immortalized her name.

When she arrived in Emond's Field, she was described as having dark hair that hung in ringlets. She looked the same age as Nynaeve but with large dark eyes that belong to a much older woman. She was relatively short, like most Cairhienin, standing at 5'2", and had a melodious voice. She wore a sky-blue velvet cloak with vines and flowers along the edges in thick silver embroidery, a golden woven belt, and a dark blue dress slashed with cream. She wore her Great Serpent ring on the second finger of her left hand, though she was known to change the finger. Moiraine also wore the traditional Cairhienien kesiera, hers being a small sparkling blue stone held by a fine golden chain.

Moiraine is notable as a channeler in several ways aside from being born with the ability. Firstly, her original strength was once considered exceptionally strong in the One Power among Aes Sedai. Among the Aes Sedai active just before the White Tower Schism, only three equaled her in strength: Siuan Sanche, who was Amyrlin Seat for a time; Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan, advisor to the Queen of Andor and Amyrlin after Siuan; and Lelaine Akashi, a prominent Sitter. The then-retired Romanda Cassin also equaled Moiraine in strength. Only one Aes Sedai surpassed Moiraine's strength: Cadsuane Melaidhrin, who was thought to be retired at the time of the schism (though in fact she had come out of retirement to deal with Logain and remained active after his apprehension).

Also known as: Moiraine, Moiraine Sedai.
